notes:
- More reliable updates: waits until Snap Mixer has fully closed before swapping, and sees new versions right away.
- Load above Unload under each filament on the computer (tidier layout).
- Updates now install silently: no more black command window while Snap Mixer restarts.
- Load and Unload buttons under each filament — on the computer (Device tab) and in the phone app.
- The U1 does the load/unload by itself; Snap Mixer shows Loading… / Unloading… and tells you if it fails.
- Phone app older than 2.6: the Update button now explains the one-time install through Chrome.
